The '''2012–13 Delaware State Hornets men's basketball team''' represented [[Delaware State University]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Hornets, led by 13th-year head coach [[Greg Jackson (basketball coach)|Greg Jackson]], played their home games at the [[Memorial Hall (Delaware State)|Memorial Hall]] and were members of the [[Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 15–18, 8–8 in MEAC play, to finish in a tie for sixth place. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2013 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]] where they lost to North Carolina A&T.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/330742169|title=NC A&T 84, Delaware St. 78|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 15, 2013|access-date=February 29, 2024}}</ref>
